chunks: The gardens of Eden which Ar-Rahman promised His servants in the unseen; verily His promise will come to pass.

key_terms.بِالْغَيْبِ: In the unseen / from the unseen
key_terms.مَأْتِيّاً: Coming to pass / bound to happen

ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the promise Allah made to His servants regarding Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the eschatological certainty of Jannat 'Adn, emphasizing that the reward is guaranteed even when its reality is hidden from human perception (bil-ghayb). It underscores the attribute of Ar-Rahman, assuring believers that divine promises are not merely potential but inevitably manifest, reinforcing trust in the unseen. This assurance serves as a spiritual anchor for the faithful during times of trial, linking the certainty of the promise to the reliability of the Promiser.
